_comment: Not a Railway file. Railway's config-as-code has no volume or variable fields, so the template composer (dashboard) is where these are declared; this file is the one list the README, the composer steps and tests/test_railway_template.py all read.

variables.BRNRD_REPO_URL: https clone URL of the repo the resident works in; start.sh clones it into /data/repo on first boot (required)
variables.GH_TOKEN: GitHub token so the daemon can clone a private repo and publish branches; runners receive it as their publishing identity (src/brr/docs/envs.md) (recommended)
variables.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: Claude login for headless boxes, from `claude setup-token` on your laptop [verify on first deploy]; alternative to the login-through-shell step (optional)
variables.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: API-key alternative to a Claude subscription login; forwarded to runners (src/brr/envs/__init__.py) (optional)
variables.BRNRD_URL: brnrd base URL for pairing; default https://brnrd.dev, set only for a self-hosted backend (optional)
